full_judgment: A.T.M. Afzal, J:- In this appeal by leave, the question for consideration is whether the plaintiff-appellant was non-suited upon a correct view of section 86 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act 1950 (hereinafter referred to as the Act) as substituted by the Bangladesh State Acquisition and Tenancy (Fourth Amendment) Order 1972 (President's Order No.135 of 1972.)
